title: Demo: the proving ground
body: This is a demo entry. The proving ground and the walled courtyard are test maps: nothing on them happened, and the units on them are nobody in particular.
In the campaign, each chapter has an entry like this one listing exactly what the game invents.

title: Demo: the Three Postures
body: This is a demo entry. Spear beats mace, mace beats sabre, and sabre beats spear.
The triangle is a rule of this game. No source describes fighting this way.
